ios.desc:
We make meals simple.

Introducing My Cart! - the ultimate shopping & recipe app that saves you time and money.

Tired of overspending on groceries and dining out? With My Cart!, you can easily compare prices among some of the larger grocery retailers, ensuring you get the best deals on all your meal essentials. Say goodbye to impulse purchases and hello to smart savings. Whether you're planning a family dinner or need to get ingredients for a quick bite, My Cart! is your go-to companion for affordable, delicious meals.

How does it work? What makes My Cart! different or better?

Here's what sets us apart:

1. We save you money. Period. Compare prices from different grocery stores and find the best deals - take advantage of grocery store competition by comparing meals at different locations to see which fits your budget best. Additionally, we DON'T add a surcharge! Other services might add fees for service or make you go through another other third-party provider to checkout. We don't. We cut out the third party groups and take you directly through the stores to get you the absolute best deals we can.

2. We offer dozens of recipes with an easy-add to cart feature - Find recipes you like, select the exact ingredients you need, and add it to your cart. It's that easy!

3. Schedule on your time - Skip the lines by utilizing curbside pickup or delivery, where offered.

4. Read the print - According to the Wall Street Journal, grocery stores are the cheapest and easiest way to get groceries and meals, beating out ALL meal solution kits. We do the heavy lifting to help save you time and money!

5. We're still growing - Unlike meal kits that only offer you a few dozen recipes, we offer over 60 in-house recipes and thousands of additional recipes you can search for!

6. We listen to feedback - You can reach us via email and make suggestions. We read every suggestion, comment, and idea.

7. We don't sell your data!

We take feedback seriously! We are continuously adding new items, meals, and stores to the app to maximize the amount of time you can save with shopping and the amount of money you spend each month. With that in mind, we strongly encourage users to send in feedback of things they want to see added or removed. If you have a meal you want added, or a store you want to shop at, let us know! We will do our best to add in suggestions as we continue to grow.

quotes.text:
Hi everyone,

I have recently launched the My Cart app and would love to get feedback on the app. I built My Cart as a way to provide better insight and transparency into grocery prices while also providing dozens of recipes available for people to use and make. I even added in a "generate" feature which lets you search for thousands of recipes.

You can try the app here:
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/my-cart/id6450795988
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dxt.mealstogo
